Snow, Jr. A CONCURRENT RESOLUTION OF THE 45TH LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF  UTAH, THE GOVERNOR CONCURRING THEREIN; COMMENDING THE UTAH LUNG  ASSOCIATION FOR ITS WORK IN PREVENTING AND CONTROLLING LUNG  DISEASE; APPLAUDING THE ASSOCIATION FOR ITS CHILDHOOD ASTHMA  PROGRAM AND RUNNING LEVELS CHALLENGE; AND PROVIDING THAT THE  ASSOCIATION BE PRESENTED A COPY OF THE RESOLUTION. On motion of Senator Snow, and under suspension of the rules, S.C.R. No. 2 was  read the first, second and third times and passed on the following roll call: Yeas, 20; Nays, 0; Absent, 9 Voting in the affirmative were: Senators Asay Christensen Money Stratford Barlow Comaby Overson Swan Barton Flamm Pugh Wayment Black Matheson
